how: The invitation asks fellow readers to support putting two familiar characters on the canvas without reporting that building has begun.
A member accepts the invitation with a bare commitment that requests nothing in return.
The invitation receives a bare acceptance, supporting the written call–answer relation without establishing subsequent placing.
The proposer fits the starter role through an invitation that another member joins without evidence of appointed leadership.
The call proposes a character picture as the room's intended representation without settling a detailed design or establishing authorship of the finished figure.
The proposed site's occupancy limits available space locally while the suggestion to find another leaves the attempt open.
Discovery and an update announce a finished character without claiming that the room built it.
The update records a minimal final location and companion without narrating how the image was built.
